description: The Department for Transport publishes seven scenario workbooks from its 2018 road traffic forecasts for England and Wales, with a horizon to 2050. Outputs include traffic, emissions, average speed, average delay and congested conditions. The scenarios vary economic, fuel-price, migration, trip-rate and vehicle assumptions. They were produced using the National Transport Model and are useful for comparing transport demand and capacity-planning assumptions. The public page lists seven Excel workbooks and a report, available without charge under the stated Open Government Licence terms, subject to exceptions. Caveats: no workbook or report was downloaded; units, first forecast year, geographic subdivisions and numerical quality remain unverified. These are scenario projections; they are not measured traffic counts. The 2022 projection release uses updated scenarios and is recorded separately. Both releases are linked to the existing National Transport Model.
